author: massicomar
title: Array Division
summary:
You are given an array containing $n$ positive integers.

Your task is to divide the array into $k$ subarrays so that the maximum sum in a subarray is as small as possible.

Input

The first input line contains two integers $n$ and $k$: the size of the array and the number of subarrays in the division.

The next line contains $n$ integers $x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n$: the contents of the array.

Output

Print one integer: the maximum sum in a subarray in the optimal division.
explanation: Minimize the maximum part sum: binary search the cap S and check with greedy cuts.
traps: The lower bound must be max(x_i).

es.explanation: Minimizar la máxima suma de una parte: búsqueda binaria sobre el tope S, y chequeo con cortes greedy.
traps: La cota inferior tiene que ser max(x_i).
